subject: AtlasAI POC onboarding, acceptance criteria, and blocker clearance plan
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura@atlasai.com>; Alex Kim <alex.kim@atlasai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 15:10:00 +0000
Subject: AtlasAI POC kickoff — post-call recap and proposed MAP

Hi Laura / Alex — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned before the POC kicks off. Please confirm or call out anything I missed.

Summary of call
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference runtime on AtlasAI conversational workflow for customer support (latency < 250ms p95, accuracy within existing intent routing).
- Scope: 2-week evaluation with a single representative model (gpt-like open model), sample dataset (~50k tokens), and a staging endpoint accessible from Atlas dev VPC.

Proposed success criteria (initial)
1) Latency: p95 <= 250ms for 1–2 concurrent users (owner: Aditya Rao)
2) Throughput: sustain 40 req/min with steady-state 10-token outputs (owner: Mina Haddad)
3) Quality: intent classification parity within 5% of baseline on provided eval set (owner: Laura Chen)
4) Security/compliance: SOC2 controls and audit logs available, data residency noted (owner: Atlas procurement)

Timeline (draft)
- Sample dataset and network allowlist due: 2027-07-15
- Staging endpoint provisioned and smoke-tested: 2027-07-18
- Evaluation window: 2027-07-19 to 2027-07-30
- Go/no-go decision: 2027-07-30

Immediate asks
- Laura: confirm the eval set and point-of-contact for dataset transfer (SFTP or presigned URL)
- Alex: confirm VPC peering / allowlist window for 7/15–7/18
- Procurement: confirm SOC2 evidence expectations and any required legal docs

Risks we discussed
- Data egress / residency constraints (mitigation: isolated staging in your VPC + encrypted-at-rest config)
- Model variant compatibility (mitigation: run quantized variant or fallback to hosted small model)

Attachment: mutual_action_plan_atlas_v1.xlsx (Excel, 120KB) — draft owners & dates included

If that looks right I’ll upload the updated MAP and kick off provisioning tasks.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Laura Chen <laura@atlasai.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Kim <alex.kim@atlasai.com>, AtlasAI Procurement <procurement@atlasai.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: AtlasAI POC kickoff — post-call recap and proposed MAP

Thanks Mina — this is helpful and mostly aligned. A few clarifications and one small change to success criteria.

Clarifications / additions
- Acceptance tests: we will provide a 600-sample labeled eval set for intent parity. Our bar: F1 delta <= 0.05 versus current infra.
- Data transfer: procurement prefers SFTP (we will send credentials by 7/14) — notify when ready.
- Compliance: SOC2 Type II report plus evidence for logging and retention; we need confirmed audit-log export (S3 bucket) accessible to Atlas.

Change request
- Add stability criterion: no more than 2 reproducible errors per 500 requests during evaluation (owner: Aditya / Redwood infra).

Procurement note
- I’ll loop procurement for the SOW and any DPA items. They’ve asked for preliminary pricing outline before SOW draft.

Attachment: Atlas_POC_requirements.docx (DOCX, 45KB) — internal checklist from our infra team.

I’ll confirm the POC dataset owner and share SFTP creds by 7/14. Happy to jump on a 20-minute sync if helpful.

—Laura
Laura Chen
Head of Integrations | AtlasAI
laura@atlasai.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura@atlasai.com>; Alex Kim <alex.kim@atlasai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 16:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: AtlasAI POC kickoff — updated owners, timeline, and contingencies

Thanks Laura — updated per your note. I’ve attached a revised MAP and pulled the owners into explicit tasks below so nothing falls through the cracks.

Updated owners & actions
- Dataset transfer & SFTP setup: Atlas (Laura) — due 2027-07-14
- Network allowlist and peering validation: Atlas (Alex) + Redwood infra (Aditya) — due 2027-07-15
- Staging endpoint provisioning and smoke test: Aditya (owner) — due 2027-07-18
- Eval run (automated scripts + manual checks): Mina + Atlas ops — 2027-07-19 to 2027-07-30
- Go/no-go review: Mina + Laura + Marissa — decision by 2027-07-30

Contingency / mitigation plan (high-level)
- If we hit image/compatibility issues with your model format: fallback option is to run a quantized variant we’ve validated for similar architectures (2–3% quality delta typical). If you prefer exact parity, we will schedule a short kernel build (48–72h estimate).
- If SOC2 evidence needs more time: proceed with functional eval while SOC2 review runs in parallel; restrict PII from the sample dataset in the interim.

Next steps from our side
- I’ll create the provisioning ticket and loop Aditya to stand up the staging endpoint once SFTP is confirmed.
- Priyom — can you prepare a draft pricing outline and a simple SOW template for Atlas procurement to review?

Attachment: mutual_action_plan_atlas_v1.xlsx (updated)

Mina

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Laura Chen <laura@atlasai.com>, Alex Kim <alex.kim@atlasai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 07:58:00 +0000
Subject: Provisioning note — potential blocker and suggested mitigations

Folks — quick technical update from provisioning attempts this morning.

Observed issue
- The model package Atlas provided (onnx bundle) uses a custom op set that our current GPU image does not include. When we attempt to load the model the runtime throws: "MissingKernel(CustomOp_XYZ)" and the container exits shortly after. See attached error log.

Immediate mitigations (recommended)
1) Short path (48–72 hrs): Build and ship a kernel plugin for CustomOp_XYZ to the staging image. This requires infra dev time but preserves identical model behavior.
2) Fast path (same-day): Convert the model to the quantized variant we validated last quarter. Expect ~2–4% quality delta; reduces runtime incompatibility risk and lets Atlas run the functional eval window on schedule.
3) Workaround: Host the model via Redwood-hosted compatible variant (different model repo) as a temporary fallback while kernel work completes.

Impact to timeline
- If we take path 1, staging endpoint will slip to ~2027-07-20 (estimate).
- If we take path 2, we can stay on the original schedule but need sign-off from Atlas on the quality tradeoff by EOD 2027-07-13.

Attachment: provisioning_error_log.txt (plain text)

Please confirm preferred mitigation so we can mobilize the engineering work. If we don’t hear back by EOD PST 7/13 I’ll open an escalation ticket and loop in infra engineering for priority.

—Aditya
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Chen <laura@atlasai.com>, Alex Kim <alex.kim@atlasai.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 09:05:00 +0000
Subject: Escalation plan + decision path for Atlas POC blocker

Thanks Aditya — and thanks Laura/Atlas for the quick responses. To keep this moving we’ll do the following unless Atlas requests otherwise:

1) Default mitigation: convert to the validated quantized variant for the eval window (path 2). Atlas to confirm quality acceptance by EOD 7/13.
2) Parallel work: Aditya/infra to start the kernel plugin spec in parallel — if Atlas needs parity we’ll escalate engineering and prioritize a 48–72h build.
3) Commercial contingency: Priyom, please prepare a one-week credit and extension clause we can offer if we need to slip the go/no-go past 7/30 due to infra remediation.
4) Escalation path: If unresolved by 7/15, Marissa will escalate to VP Product and request an SLA exception for dedicated kernel work.

Please reply with a one-line confirmation ("accept quantized path" or "require kernel parity") so we can lock tasks and notify procurement.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
